problems: No state is new and no row was split or merged: Beylik of Isfendiyar and Beylik of Sinop (Q2096678) are different states (Sinop = Pervaneid emirate 1277-1322, annexed by the Candars in 1322); Kastamonu is listed in beylik-of-isfendiyar cliopatria_names as the kastamonu author and reviewer asked.

Conflict with germiyanids (me-09-f): its Hamid gains of 1333 and 1344 (confidence 1, Cliopatria only) and its 1363 Ankara lobe overlap beylik-of-hamid (kept to 1391 on the Hamidids page) and ahi-republic (to 1362).

ottoman-empire (me-10) lacks the mirrors: gain Karaman 1397/loss 1402, gain Aydin 1390/loss 1402, gain Kastamonu country 1391 (Candar)/loss 1402, gain Hamid 1391, Karasi 1345 (dossier 1346), Ahi 1362 (dossier 1363) with a 1354 occupation, Candar 1461 (dossier 1462), and Karaman 1468 should exclude the Taurus rump until 1487 (beylik-of-karaman_1468).

ilkhanate (ia-02): vassal counterparts beylik-of-sinop/kastamonu 1309-1335 should be beylik-of-isfendiyar; ahi-republic (Mongol suzerainty c. 1290) is missing; Karaman's 1326 strip has no Ilkhanid loss. byzantine-empire (eu-05) lacks losses for the Karasi coast (1308) and Ephesus (1304).

Cliopatria shapes corrected beyond years: Aydin lacks Birgi and Smyrna; Ahi shape omits Ankara city; Karaman row ends 1467 but the state lasts to 1487 (rump keyframe); Karasi expansion 1308 not 1326; Hamid Teke split 1321 not 1326.
